dataList.content:
Are you the Floor Manager of B2F?
你们就是B2F的楼层经理，没错吧？
dataList.place:
Skein Nest, B2F
B2F 线团之巢

dataList.content:
You've found them. We are spinners of thread, and we manage this floor.
没错。我们负责管理这一层，也负责纺织丝线。
dataList.title:
Grand Magasin Sisyphe
西西弗百货

dataList.content:
Tell me what it is you seek.
说出你们的诉求吧。
dataList.title:
Grand Magasin Sisyphe
西西弗百货

dataList.content:
If your wish does not fall out of step with the voice of fate, I shall grant it.
如果那不违背命运之声，便能给予你们。
dataList.title:
Grand Magasin Sisyphe
西西弗百货

dataList.content:
We have accepted a commission from Le Noir and come to make a Golden Skein.
我们受黑派所托，前来制作黄金线团。

The Floor Manager regarded the Authenticity Certificate Meursault produced with little interest—until the cocoon caught their eye, and a broad smile spread across their lips.
楼层经理毫不关心地看着默尔索拿出的鉴定报告和配方，而在看到茧时却露出了一抹微笑。

A Golden Cocoon... You have brought me a precious material—that of a being of eld.
黄金之茧……你们带来了相当高贵且古老的材料啊。
dataList.title:
Grand Magasin Sisyphe
西西弗百货

dataList.content:
But... there's something missing.
不过……还有所不足。
dataList.title:
Grand Magasin Sisyphe
西西弗百货

dataList.content:
I could spin fine thread from this... but the cocoon alone cannot yield the Golden Skein.
我们能纺出优秀的线……却不能凭此做出黄金线团。
dataList.title:
Grand Magasin Sisyphe
西西弗百货

dataList.content:
<The recipe didn't list anything else... Do we need another ingredient?>
<但配方上也没有其他的材料了……还需要什么别的吗？>

... What? Need a G.B. or something?
……要什么？金·之吗？

She is asking whether a Golden Bough is required, Manager.
她想说是否需要金枝，经理。

Tsk... G.B. means Golden Buildingskin, not Golden Bough.
啧……不是金枝，而是黄金之皮革。

... I see.
……是吗。

I assume you mean the Golden Hide. It is not a suitable medium for coloring thread, child.
皮革并不适合给线染色呀。
dataList.title:
Grand Magasin Sisyphe
西西弗百货

dataList.content:
Go to the Dyehouse and fetch the Golden Dye.
从染色室拿来黄金染料吧。
dataList.title:
Grand Magasin Sisyphe
西西弗百货

dataList.content:
Palette has been gathering it with great care, one drop at a time.
那都是调色板一滴一滴小心翼翼收集回来的。
dataList.title:
Grand Magasin Sisyphe
西西弗百货

dataList.content:
... I expect this will cost another mountain of eyeballs.
……既然是那么贵重的东西，想必需要花费许多眼球吧。

<At least spending them raises our Prestige Tier.>
<不过花得越多，在百货店的评级也越会上升吧。>

<We'll eventually be allowed onto the upper floors if we keep this up...>
<只要一直花下去，总能到上面一层的……>

<Let's go to the Dyehouse.>
<我们去染色室吧。>
